RESOLVED: Round-1 MINOR 1. _retrieval_state now attributes from n=len(results) and retrieval_limit; the used>=budget heuristic is gone. Independent explain_search probe: retrieve_sources(byte_budget=128, limit=5) yields results=0 omitted=1 used=2; the coverage sibling reports retrieval_truncated=false and byte_budget_omission.omitted=true omitted_item_count=1 byte_budget=128 used_bytes=2; search sibling equals retrieve_sources and is not mutated.

NOTE: Additional probes: explain_search(limit=1, byte_budget=8192) over three alpha files returns n=1 omitted=2 retrieval_truncated=true byte_budget_omission.omitted=false; retrieval_limit=None with omitted=1 reports truncation and budget omitted=false; n=2 with retrieval_limit=1 is CoverageError retrieval_limit_mismatch; retrieval_limit in {0, 101, True, -1} is invalid_retrieval_limit.

ACCEPTED-RESIDUAL: Round-1 MINOR 2. Coordinator declined exclusivity of retrieval_truncated and byte_budget_omission.omitted. SEMANTICS.md names them independent completeness disclosures (retrieval candidate/result limits versus serialized UTF-8 budget use). validate_receipt still accepts a digest-consistent dual-true pair; the producer never emits that pair. Reviewer accepts that residual.

NOTE: Fix-round diff is confined to _retrieval_state, keyword-only retrieval_limit (1-100) on build_coverage_receipt, two typed refusals, and tests (retrieve_sources import; helper wiring; one truncation/budget test replaced by three attribution tests). validate_receipt semantics, schema, status table, and search consumption are unchanged.
source_grounding_result: Unchanged from round 1: receipts bind project identity, checkout_id against sha256(utf-8 of root.resolve()), corpus fingerprint plus index_policy_digest, and registry digest. Bindings reopen through verify_source_bindings; source_drift is refined to missing, version_changed, digest_changed, or unavailable. Traversal, symlink, cross-project, and privacy failures remain typed errors with no receipt.
privacy_result: The receipt still carries query_digest only. Query and source privacy refusals use stable reason/field strings. Invalid and inconsistent retrieval_limit refusals echo neither query nor source. Nothing is persisted. The explain_search byte-budget probe left the search object unmutated.
retrieval_quality_result: The search object is consumed unchanged and is never re-ranked. Truncation and byte-budget flags never change answerability. With retrieval_limit, omitted==0 clears both flags; n<limit attributes every omission to the byte budget; n==limit discloses retrieval truncation only because further budget drops cannot be recovered from retrieve_sources fields; n>limit is refused; retrieval_limit=None keeps the unknown-cause truncation disclosure. explain_search now supplies retrieval_limit=limit, so the original budget-drop probe is attributed correctly.
compatibility_result: Additive keyword-only retrieval_limit: int | None = None on build_coverage_receipt. Default None preserves the prior unknown-cause disclosure. No change to search output, context v1, cache, ledger, MCP, configuration, or validate_receipt cross-field rules.
rollback_result: Delete palimnex/coverage.py and palimnex/tests/test_coverage.py. No wire identifier, cache, or ledger migration is involved.
authority_result: approved_registry bound to the checkout project is required. candidate_set, foreign project, unsafe paths, and authorizes_actions true are refused. Documents remain evidence_only with authorizes_actions false. No approved registry was created.
limitations: Full unittest suite and scripts/palimnex_check.sh were not run, as instructed.
